geometry_source: artifacts/data/population_capacity/location_geometry_calibrated.parquet; same national selector and exclusions as the vetted England 1290-1315 scale anchor

crosswalks.historical_boundary: England within the Great Britain reconstruction, excluding Wales and all Scottish areas
crosswalks.resolution_method: Reused the audited national England selector from the existing england_1290_1315 scale anchor because both records explicitly refer to the same England boundary. No location-level population or starting-population field is used in the crosswalk.
crosswalks.notes: This is not an independent geographic group. Source-family and geographic-family holdouts must keep this record with the existing England scale anchor. The capacity interval comes from independent food-security/model literature, not from the EU5 starting population map.
